$comment: Hand-editable. Category derivation is a lossy judgement call, so it lives in data rather than code and can be retuned without touching the pipeline. rawCategories is retained on every record so the taxonomy can be re-derived offline at any time. Terms below were chosen against the real category frequency tally in plans/reports/category-coverage.md, not guessed.

reject.$comment: Maintenance and template bookkeeping. Matched against the category name with the 'Thể loại:' prefix already stripped. Every rejected string is counted in the coverage report so over-rejection stays visible rather than silent.
exact: Bản dịch của Wikisource không có tên bản gốc
Tác phẩm không tồn tại trang tác gia

route.$comment: Categories that are not subjects at all. These populate dedicated record fields in the adapter and must never surface as browsable facets.

groups.$comment: Maps a surviving category to a top-level facet. Matching is case-insensitive substring against the NFC-normalised name. Diacritics are NOT stripped here, so 'phú' will not match 'phủ'. ORDER MATTERS: the first group with a matching term wins, so narrower legal and documentary groups are listed before broader literary ones.
